purpose: Freeze the collapse thresholds before any M3 candidate exists. CLAUDE.md records a gate chosen after the fact rejecting a working metric three times.

calibration_source.origin: M0 continuation generations from the published Stage 2 and Stage 3 checkpoints

repeat_count_note: Only 3 of 20 generations contain ANY 3-gram occurring more than once, and all three occur exactly twice.

rationale.max_ngram_repeats: M0's working checkpoints reach 2. Four leaves a factor of two of headroom while still firing on the classic collapse signature, a phrase repeated five or more times.
rationale.min_distinct_ratio: M0's floor is 0.7727. At 0.4 the backstop sits a factor of 1.93 below anything a working checkpoint produced, so it fires only on severe degeneracy and not on ordinary repetition.
rationale.max_emitted_ratio: NOT calibrated on a healthy control, and this matters. M0's partner channel is digital silence, so M0's 0.097-0.218 says what a model does when nobody is speaking, not what a healthy model does when someone is. 0.85 is set as a GROSS monologue detector: a model emitting text on 85% of frames is talking through the user's entire turn.

how_to_read_a_failure.control_first: The J-Moshi-ext control generated at plan step 22 is the first healthy checkpoint measured against a speaking partner. Its emitted_ratio must be reported in m3-collapse.json next to every candidate's.
how_to_read_a_failure.if_the_control_fails: If the control itself exceeds max_emitted_ratio, the THRESHOLD is wrong, not the candidate. Record it as a calibration failure, re-derive the threshold from the control, and say so in the report - do not fail condition 3 on it.
how_to_read_a_failure.vacuous_metrics_excluded: b_never_active and other partner-channel activity measures must NOT corroborate condition 3. With --model_user_stream the user stream is teacher-forced for every arm, so the partner always looks active and the metric is a tautology.

self_check.assertion: The thresholds do not fire on any of M0's 20 working generations.
